title: Rootline walkthrough: getting found, website, quotes and reviews
description: A clickable walkthrough of how a Columbus landscape company wins work: a website built from its own jobs and plant knowledge, an AI receptionist that answers after hours, marketplace leads deduplicated, consent and quiet hours, a fall campaign with a personal price for every client, neighbor door hangers from the route, review requests without gating, referrals, social posts, a win-back offer and ROI measured to collected revenue in the ledger.
